description: Header file defining a task fork limiter and executor classes for controlling concurrent task execution with prioritization and batching.

classes.name: task_fork_limiter_executor
classes.description: Executor class for a task_fork_limiter with a specific priority level, dispatching tasks to the limiter.

classes.name: task_fork_limiter
classes.description: Main class implementing a task fork limiter that manages concurrent task execution, prioritization, batching, and internal queues.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a task with a given priority, dispatching it to the limiter.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a task with a given priority, scheduling it for later execution.

methods.name: get_executors
methods.description: Returns the list of executors for different priority levels.

methods.name: handle_fork_tasks
methods.description: Handles execution of tasks in a fork, respecting batch limits.

methods.name: handle_failed_dispatch
methods.description: Handles failure to dispatch a task, reverting active fork count.

methods.name: pop_task
methods.description: Attempts to pop a task from internal queues, with retries and failure handling.

methods.name: job_enqueued
methods.description: Updates internal state when a new job is enqueued, possibly creating a new fork.

methods.name: reserve_fork_task
methods.description: Reserves a task for a fork, updating state accordingly.
